passives.name: Void Corruption
passives.description: Each second in combat with enemy champions makes your damage to champions 3% stronger, up to 9% after 3s. At full strength the bonus ignores armor and magic resist (it is 9% of the damage before resistances, like true damage).
passives.if: t_champion and in_combat and not t_self and combat_time >= 1

effects.mult: 1 + 0.03 * floor(combat_time) * int(combat_time < 3) + 0.09 * int(combat_time >= 3) * (1 + int(dtype == 'magic') * max(t_mr * (1 - stat('magic_pen_percent')) - stat('magic_pen'), 0) / 100 + int(dtype == 'physical') * max(t_armor * (1 - stat('armor_pen')) - lethality * (0.6 + 0.4 * min(level, 18) / 18), 0) / 100)
